name: Clay animation restyle
description: Restyle the video as clay animation with sculpted forms, tactile surfaces and soft studio lighting.

prompt.default: The source video remade from scratch as a stop-motion claymation film on a miniature set. All real materials are replaced with plasticine: foliage becomes lumps of clay, stone and walls become smooth clay slabs, the ground becomes rolled clay and the sky a painted clay backdrop, with chunky simplified shapes and visible fingerprints. Not live action, not a photograph, not CGI. Only the layout, action and camera move of the source video stay the same.
